{{Top|leg}}
The '''maraffa '''was a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]]. It was renowned for its pleasant odor and [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Sap/Legends|sap]]. The sticky sap was considered a [[Sugar/Legends|sugary]] treat and the [[Maraffa twig|twigs]] from the maraffa tree were often sold as [[Candy/Legends|candy]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
